high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from the ESPNcricinfo app, displaying live commentary of a cricket match between England (ENG) and India during the 1st Test at Nottingham, which took place from August 4 to August 8, 2021, as part of the India tour of England. The top section shows the time as 8:02 and the battery level at 42%. The ESPNcricinfo logo is prominently displayed with a blue background. There's a back arrow on the left side for navigation. A notification bell icon
